features:
Features:

• Professional group management
• Anti-spam, anti-link, and anti-flood
• Warnings and member management
• Group management panel
• Persian and English AI
• Mini App dashboard

Quick guide for group admins:
• /panel — open the group management panel
• /settings — view management settings
• /warn — warn a user by replying to their message
• /ban — ban a user by replying to their message
• /unban — remove a user's ban by replying
• /unmute — remove restrictions by replying
• /autodelete 10m — automatically delete user messages after 10 minutes
• /autodelete off — disable automatic deletion
• /delete — delete a replied message
• /delete 10 — delete the 10 most recent tracked messages

The bot needs the required admin permissions in the group for management features.
admin: Add the bot to your group and grant admin permission to enable the full security and management features.
